CustomField.description: Composite unique key: Use_Case_Key__c + '|' + the UTC day key (e.g. 'PortfolioNarrative|2026-09-28'). Mirrors AI_Usage_Day__c.Day_Key__c's own unique-external-id-arbitrates-concurrent-first-request pattern, but scoped per use case instead of tenant-wide, since Day_Key__c alone is already unique on AI_Usage_Day__c and can't be reused for a second, per-use-case counter.
CustomField.label: Use Case Day Key
